title: Requirement registry
description: The requirement IDs one family version's spec.md declares, as registry/requirements.json projects them. spec.md is normative: the file is generated from it by task docs, and a file that disagrees with it fails task check:docs. Within a major version an ID is never removed and its anchor never changes.

family.description: The family that declares these requirements, as its directory under specifications/ names it.

major.description: The major version directory, such as v2.

requirements.description: Every requirement the family version declares, in the order its spec.md states them.

Requirement.description: One requirement: a single rule a document or an implementation can be held to.

id.description: The stable requirement ID, such as CORE-ENV-001.

anchor.description: The fragment that locates the requirement in the family version's spec.md.

section.description: The anchor of the section that states the requirement. Informative: a requirement may move between sections without changing its ID.
